Document: # Metashielded The chemicals in this list are hidden from most of the general crew. Only the Chief Medical Officer, Captain, Central Command staff, and related antags to the chemical posses knowledge of their existance. The general crew are not allowed to know of these chemicals existance unless they are told they exist or they find the chemical naturally.
